IRIS %1$s

An independent Intel map companion for Ingress, based on IITC. This is an early friends-testing build, not an official Niantic or Google app.

Report problems using Feedback, with your app version, Android version, and what happened. Diagnostics can be copied from the App menu. Review them before sharing; avoid account details and private portal information.

If the map cannot start, try Reload or App → Recovery → Stock Intel. You can return to IRIS from the same menu. Google sign-in currently uses an experimental compatibility workaround; saved-password support may vary.

IRIS does not operate an analytics or crash-reporting service. Feedback and copied diagnostics are only shared when you choose to send them.

Intel and sign-in pages contact Niantic and your sign-in provider. The Android WebView retains session cookies and local settings on this device; IRIS does not send them to an IRIS-operated server. Signing in uses an embedded browser compatibility workaround.

Map requests go to the selected provider: OpenStreetMap or OpenFreeMap and their resources. Address searches send your query to OpenStreetMap Nominatim. These providers receive network information such as your IP address and requested map areas. Portal and mission images load from their supplied hosts.

Location is requested only when you tap Locate and uses Android foreground location permission. The map centers on the result, so subsequent map requests can reveal that area to map providers. No background location permission is requested.

Preferences, map view, and drawn links/markers are stored locally. Clipboard actions copy the data you select to your device clipboard. Clear Android app storage or uninstall to remove the app session/settings. Logout signs out of Intel while preserving preferences.

For privacy questions, contact the maintainer through the GitHub project linked by Feedback. Do not include passwords, session cookies, or tokens in reports.

IRIS mode starts automatically on signed-in Intel and prevents the stock dashboard runtime from loading. Stock Intel restores the original page; Reload keeps the selected mode. Google sign-in stays in this WebView using the IITC-style user-agent compatibility workaround. This is an experiment, not a supported Google OAuth integration. No cookies, tokens, player identity, or request bodies are included here.
